name: Argonne Science Discovery Camp
what_you_do: A free five-day camp for younger teens. You work in groups on hands-on science projects, interview scientists and engineers, and tour Argonne labs.
who_can_apply: Students who will be in 8th or 9th grade in the fall. You must attend all five days and get yourself to Argonne.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed. Last cycle, families applied by mid-April and heard back in early May.
how_to_apply: A family submits an application on the camp page when it opens. Only 24 students are picked.
notes: Send questions to the email on the camp page: education@anl.gov. It is a good first step before the high school camps.
